figures.title: This paper in the 13 components, against the field
figures.subtitle: Each box: what this paper does, then common practice across all sensors and how many ledger papers share it.
figures.caption: Verdicts compare the paper's choice for each component with common practice across 8,995 ledger entries on any sensor (silent speech, brain-to-text, lip reading).

choice: Cued covert pronunciation, no user training
CSP variant, features and kernels chosen from observed CV accuracy; no held-out selection set
M03.field: Per-subject calibration; nested selection 1 of 7 prior
M03.note: Nested selection only in one prior (Yoshimura 2016); fewer than 3 for behind.

choice: Covert vowels and words; cue in analysed interval
M04.note: Inherited; authors analyse the visual-cue window to avoid auditory responses (§4.1).

choice: CSP + covariance tangent vectors + multiclass RVM
M06.field: Hand-crafted features + shallow classifier, of 7 prior
M06.note: Absent in 0 of 7 priors; gains over at-chance baselines, uncorrected tests, accuracy-based tuning.

choice: Within-subject random 10-fold CV over whole trials; chance stated, not tested
M12.field: Accuracy tested against chance, of 7 prior
M12.note: Chance stated, not tested; 3 priors test it [@deng2010eeg].
